entries.proposition: Figure 3: the non-responder group is not one group. Panel A (six patients) and panel C (four) show white KDT-monotherapy bars before ASM was added, with the legend saying they were initially responsive; panels B and D (seven) never responded. At least ten of the 17 non-responders therefore lost an initial response (secondary failure) and seven failed from the start.
